title: Estimator program polynomial cost bound
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $\mathcal{F}$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$ be rational. For every outcome in the support of the estimator program's output-and-cost distribution, its number of random examples, viewed as a rational number, is at most $16|\mathcal{F}|^3\lceil\log_2(20|\mathcal{F}|)\rceil/\varepsilon^2$; its number of queries is zero; and its work, viewed as a rational number, is at most $16|\mathcal{F}|^3(n+2)\lceil\log_2(20|\mathcal{F}|)\rceil/\varepsilon^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal{F}$ is a finite nonempty family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
The outcome belongs to the support of the estimator program's output-and-cost distribution
